criteria.requirement: Open to anyone interested in Internet policy, connectivity, safety and security; the page sets no nationality or country restriction.
criteria.applicant: Citizen and resident of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: The program is open to anyone interested in building their knowledge and skills in Internet policy, community mobilization, connectivity, Internet safety, and security.

criteria.requirement: A high level of reading, speaking and writing in English.
criteria.applicant: English is listed among the profile's languages, with no level and no test score.
criteria.missing: The applicant's level of reading, speaking and writing in English.
criteria.quote: Applicants must have a high level of reading, speaking, and writing skills in English.

criteria.requirement: A valid passport that remains valid at least six months beyond fellowship-related travel dates.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant holds a passport valid six months beyond travel in 2027.
criteria.quote: Applicants must hold a valid passport that remains valid for at least six months beyond anticipated fellowship-related travel dates.

criteria.requirement: Enrol in the Pre-Fellowship Training before 22 November 2026 and complete it before applying.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant enrols before 22 November 2026 and completes the modules.
criteria.quote: participants must enroll in the required Pre-Fellowship Training modules before 22 November 2026

criteria.requirement: Weekly sessions and at least four hours a week during the 10-month programme.
criteria.missing: Availability for weekly sessions and four hours a week in 2027.
criteria.quote: Applicants must have the availability to take part in weekly sessions and be able to dedicate a minimum of four hours per week during the 10-month program.

funding.conditions: Project stipend for justified direct project costs, subject to review and approval of the project budget; not personal compensation and not for salaries or consulting fees.
funding.quote: Selected fellows may apply for a project stipend of up to USD $5,000 for justified direct project costs.

funding.conditions: Selected fellows receive 'travel support' to attend one global or regional Internet event; the page and the brochure do not say whether it pays the flight, accommodation or visa.
funding.quote: Travel support to attend a global or regional Internet event

cycles.quote: Eligible participants may submit their application as soon as they receive the application link and no later than 18 December 2026
